Link between the aircraft fuel system and the HPP; meters fuel to the thermal engine

One propeller per HPP

Description: One controller/inverter function per electric motor assembly
Notes: Installed in EM: the EM-{n} token comes from the motor and is not restated at this level.

Description: One HVDC assembly per nacelle, four in total; each holds twelve battery packs, one master BMS, one charge controller and the HVPDU
Notes: One per nacelle rather than four at aircraft level: the nacelle control bus addresses its packs as PACK-1..12 within NAC-{n}, which only closes if the twelve packs are nacelle-local. No token is restated here.

Description: One HVPDU per HVDC assembly, feeding the two motor controllers of the nacelle
Notes: Function is distribution rather than storage, hence PDS. Installed in the engine bay (J1) while the packs sit in the aft nacelle (J4).

Description: One IMD per HVPDU
Notes: Working assumption

Description: Twelve battery packs per HVDC assembly
Notes: Twelve packs per HVDC assembly. Token uses {n}, unpadded, so 10 and above stay multi-digit.

Description: Nominal pack monitoring and control
Notes: One per pack. Cell-level acquisition is internal to the pack and is not modelled.

Description: HVDC-level coordination and aircraft interface
Notes: Separate LRU from the pack BMUs.

Description: Charging protocol and command function
Aircraft side fuel boost pump

Description: Steps the 800 V HV network down to the 28 V LV network.

Description: Steps the 28 V LV network up to the 800 V HV network.

Description: Power lever assembly; its position is acquired through the redundant power-lever channels.
Notes: Single quadrant covering both propulsion packages; per-channel sensing hardware is not modelled separately.

Description: Flap selector lever; its position is acquired by the interface control modules.
Group of cockpit panels carrying the switches and pushbuttons that have no dedicated component of their own.

Description: Cockpit display unit; receives the display picture from the data concentrator over the display bus.
